title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter:

"Board" means the Hawaii board of optometry.

"Director" means the director of commerce and consumer affairs.

"Ophthalmic lens" means any spectacle lens that has a spherical, cylindrical, or prismatic power or value and is ground pursuant to a prescription.

"Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means.
bodyHtml:
§459-1.5  Definitions.  As used in this chapter:

     "Board" means the Hawaii board of optometry.

     "Director" means the director of commerce and consumer affairs.

     "Ophthalmic lens" means any spectacle lens that has a spherical, cylindrical, or prismatic power or value and is ground pursuant to a prescription.

     "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means. [L 1987, c 152, §2; am L 1997, c 335, §1; am L 2018, c 203, §6; am L 2021, c 230, §18]
